registerAndConfirm.objective: Create an account, confirm email via API token, start a JWT session, register push token.

steps.next: Show check-email UI. Do not store Authorization even if present.
Persist Authorization Bearer JWT from response header.

steps.note: Full device_token OpenAPI is a separate wave; register FCM token after JWT is stored.

signInSession.objective: Return visit for a confirmed user.

signOutSession.objective: End push delivery and revoke JWT.

steps.note: Unregister FCM token while JWT is still valid.

steps.next: Clear local JWT. Expect 204 even without a token.

passwordReset.objective: Reset password via email token, then sign in.

steps.next: No JWT issued. Prompt for signIn with new password.

updateProfile.objective: Update profile; handle reconfirmable email change.

steps.next: If email changed, login email stays until confirmUser with the new confirmation token; tell the user to check email.
Only when confirming a pending email change token from email.
